sites.enforcement_snippet:
if record.tenant_id != tenant_id:
    raise TenantAccessDeniedError(f"Tenant {tenant_id} cannot access record of {record.tenant_id}")

domain_notes: get_record returns a record only when its tenant_id matches the requesting tenant, guarded by a single cross-tenant check after the existence check. Existing tests query with the record's true owning tenant or a missing id; neither issues a cross-tenant query, so the isolation guard is never exercised.
rationale: Selected get_record because its tenant-match check is the sole isolation enforcement and no test issues a cross-tenant query.
